title: a16z Podcast: From the Internet's Past to the Future of Crypto

reader_summary.headline: What can we learn from the history of the internet for the future of crypto?
reader_summary.overview: What can we learn from the history of the internet for the future of crypto? In this episode of the a16z Podcast, general partner Katie Haun interviews a16z co-founder Marc Andreessen -- and co-founder of Netscape. This episode is based on a fireside chat between Katie and Marc at our inaugural Crypto Regulatory Summit, which brings together leading crypto experts and builders.

key_points.text: In this episode of the a16z Podcast, general partner Katie Haun interviews a16z co-founder Marc Andreessen -- and co-founder of Netscape.

Why is crypto an important evolution (or revolution) of the internet?
